## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Evidence

List the checks, measurements or experiments you performed and their results. Include relevant tool versions or hardware and print details. State what you could not test, and distinguish CAD checks, simulation runs and physical results.

## Notes for review

Mention compatibility changes, new assumptions or remaining questions. If generated assets changed, identify their source revision and how they were regenerated. Credit any third-party material and its license. Remove sections that do not apply.
